name: Onga (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the town arms of Onga: a yellow and blue shield with two figures, with a helm, a stork crest and grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed ONGA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Onga arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
